**Outcome**: WRL integrates Stripe for usage-based billing with three meters (captures, storage, API calls), self-serve plan management via Stripe Checkout and Customer Portal, and automatic VAT handling via Stripe Tax. Free tier is included quotas; overages are billed via Stripe metered billing. Live keys from day one.

**Success criteria**:
- Three Stripe meters configured: Captures (per capture), Storage (per GB-month), API Calls (per 1K calls)
- Stripe Checkout session created for plan selection; redirects tenant to Stripe-hosted payment page
- Stripe Customer Portal linked for self-serve billing management (update payment method, view invoices, cancel)
- Webhook handler processes subscription events: `customer.subscription.created`, `customer.subscription.updated`, `customer.subscription.deleted`, `invoice.payment_succeeded`, `invoice.payment_failed`
- Stripe customer ID and subscription ID stored in D1 tenant record
- Free tier provides included quotas (no payment required); overages trigger Stripe metered billing
- Stripe Tax enabled for automatic VAT/sales tax calculation based on tenant location
- Live Stripe keys used (not test keys) from initial deployment
- Payment failure triggers grace period with tenant notification; hard block after grace expires

**Scope**:
- In: Stripe Checkout integration, Customer Portal integration, webhook handler for subscription lifecycle, meter configuration, D1 tenant billing fields, Stripe Tax, grace period on payment failure
- Out: Custom pricing page (use Stripe-hosted), invoice PDF generation (Stripe handles this), multi-currency support beyond what Stripe Tax provides, annual billing plans (can add later)

**Constraints**:
- Depends on R24 (signup flow) for tenant creation that links to Stripe customer
- Depends on R26 (quotas) for quota enforcement that feeds billing meters
- Stripe webhook endpoint must verify signatures using webhook signing secret
- Must handle Stripe webhook retries idempotently (use event ID deduplication)
- Stripe API version must be pinned in code to avoid breaking changes
